race.description: Ule Hoof Oil Trotters Standing Start Hcp
race.comment: LAST CLANSMAN (13) looks close to a win having finished second in two of his last three outings here, beaten 3 metres last week. Cops a 30m handicap but has performed well from standing starts before so he is capable of another bold performance. AFFAIRE DE COVER (9) hasn't been far away of late, coming from this mark and filling a minor placing the last time he attempted a standing start here two back. Contender. BERTINELLI (11) has been about the mark of late and must be respected after working but fighting well for a close third last week at Goulburn. SHOULD BEABARCA (7) found winning form last start, coming from the back row to score at Goulburn. Could go on with it.
